text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
GLENS FALLS COMMON SCHOOL DISTRICT
WARREN COUNTY, NEW YORK
GENERAL OBLIGATION SCHOOL DISTRICT (SERIAL) BONDS, 1997
(BOOK-ENTRY-ONLY) (NON-CALLABLE) (BANK QUALIFIED)

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by the President of the Board of Education of the Glens Falls Common School District, Warren County, New York (the "School District"), at the offices of Chase Investment Services Corp., Fixed Income Department, 21st Floor, One Chase Square, Rochester, New York 14643, until 10:00 A.M.,
Prevailing Time, on
THURSDAY, APRIL 17, 1997
at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase at not less than par and accrued interest of $1,090,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, (the
"Bonds"), dated May 15, 1997, maturing on June 15 of each year as follows:
MATURITIES
The Bonds will not be subject to redemption prior to maturity.
Interest on the Bonds will be payable semi-annually on June 15 and December 15 of each year commencing June 15, 1997.

The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds will be designated as, or deemed designated as "qualified tax-exempt obligations" pursuant to Section 265 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, (the "Code").

The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. The School District will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Ruberti, Girvin & Ferlazzo, P.C., Albany, New York, on or about May 15, 1997.
Requests for copies of the Notice of Sale herein
summarized and the Official Statement relating to the Bonds and such other information as the State Comptroller may prescribe by rule or order may be directed to Bernard P.
Donegan, Inc., PO Box 70, Victor, New York 14564;
Dated: April 3, 1997 Daniel Girard
Glens Falls, New York President, Board of Education
(From The Bond Buyer)
